name: e-walnut
description: The Great Reminder App - two-tap reminder capture with native Android alarms

scripts.www: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp index.html www/ && python3 tools/bundle_fonts.py
scripts.android:add: npx cap add android && python3 tools/patch_manifest.py
scripts.sync: npx cap sync android && python3 tools/patch_manifest.py
